nodes.label: Weekly dependency updates
nodes.rationale: npm production and development dependencies are grouped separately; CodeQL Actions share a weekly update group.

nodes.label: Local beta CI
nodes.rationale: Node 24 macOS validation covers source checks, build, WebKit journeys, screenshots, audit, licenses, SBOM, release inventories and secret scanning.

nodes.label: Container canary and runtime verification
nodes.rationale: A fictional environment secret must be absent from the final filesystem, saved image layers, and image history; runtime excludes test tooling and must answer /health.

nodes.label: CI-gated static website deployment
nodes.rationale: Deploys the exact successful main push SHA from this repository; the artifact is apps/web/out.

nodes.label: Evidence Claim
nodes.rationale: A candidate-visible statement carries provenance, a locator, and pending, confirmed, rejected, or superseded state.

nodes.label: Profile Version
nodes.rationale: An immutable candidate-approved snapshot of confirmed Evidence Claims and exact authorization wording.

nodes.label: Match Publication
nodes.rationale: An immutable deterministic explanation binds one Profile Version, role snapshot, and rule version.

nodes.label: Evidence Strength Basis
nodes.rationale: Stored source-linkage counts and calculation version remain separate from fit; supported requirements are counted without weighting.

nodes.label: Dataset Edition
nodes.rationale: Historical government evidence is checksum-addressed with period, transformation identity, and review provenance.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.rationale: Candidate-owned preparation and externally reported outcomes do not reconstruct an employer process.

nodes.label: Packet
nodes.rationale: Frozen artifacts bind ordered confirmed evidence to an Application, exact Profile Version, and current Match Publication.

nodes.label: Submission Record
nodes.rationale: Append-only candidate-authored account of an external act, optionally bound to exact Packet formats, is not delivery confirmation.

nodes.label: Assurance Run
nodes.rationale: An immutable exact-artifact review can pass or block approval but is not approval itself.

nodes.label: Action Intent
nodes.rationale: Exact Packet, implementation, target, and payload require a separate candidate approval before local handoff.

nodes.label: Role Observation
nodes.rationale: An adapter establishes source identity, content hash, and provenance before common intake normalization.

nodes.label: Current Role
nodes.rationale: Mutable tenant-owned working role derived from a Role Observation.

nodes.label: Discovery Schedule
nodes.rationale: Candidate-owned recurrence refreshes an approved public board and publishes deterministic explanations.

nodes.label: Deletion Run
nodes.rationale: Resumable erasure distinguishes revoked database access, unfinished local file cleanup, and final completion.

nodes.label: Contribution and verification contract
nodes.rationale: Synthetic fixtures, public-seam tests, deterministic scoring, candidate control, and source provenance are required. Dependency changes refresh only current-candidate inventories; a successful CodeQL run does not resolve its findings.

nodes.label: PGlite PostgreSQL repository
nodes.rationale: In-process PostgreSQL supplies local storage through tenant-scoped SQL and JSONB; hosted PostgreSQL row-level security remains a separate gate.

nodes.label: Tenant deletion fence
nodes.rationale: Tenant row locks serialize writes and provider effects with deletion; deletion captures cleanup inventory before later writes are refused.

nodes.label: Staged packet and assurance lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Private staging, tenant-locked frozen-input revalidation, complete artifact promotion, and latest exact-hash assurance compare-and-swap prevent partial or obsolete approval.

nodes.label: Deny-by-default source registry
nodes.rationale: Adapter execution requires enabled state, allowed execution, and no emergency pause; implemented adapters do not establish source rights.

nodes.label: ats_routing_v1
nodes.rationale: Read-time routing accepts approved adapter-owned HTTPS targets or exact recognized ATS host and identifier paths; it makes no request and rewrites no retained Role URL.

nodes.label: ats_verification_v1
nodes.rationale: Candidate-requested fixed-host rechecks distinguish definitive detail 404 from complete-list absence; blocked or partial checks preserve last successful state.

nodes.label: DiscoveryCycle
nodes.rationale: Direct import commits a bounded source batch without scoring; scheduled refresh leases work and uses exact-snapshot MatchPublication. Cycles claim at most three schedules and 500 roles per source, with dead letters after five consecutive failures.

nodes.label: Exact-approved action lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Current-packet checks and immutable intent hashes bind creation, approval, and execution under tenant locks. Runtime approval resets off; interrupted or uncertain effects become ambiguous and never automatically retry.

nodes.label: Dataset Edition trust bundle
nodes.rationale: Admission snapshots server-trusted provenance, language review, and employer-resolution evaluation; checksum or review drift fails before signal writes.

nodes.label: Hosted trust layer
nodes.rationale: Managed RLS, passkeys, encrypted objects, protected OAuth, queue isolation, backup and deletion evidence, and counsel-reviewed terms remain production gates.

nodes.label: Large-tenant Dashboard budget
nodes.rationale: Synthetic 1,000-role and 10,000-answer-revision fixture enforces serialized payload below 4 MiB and excludes revisions arrays; timings are observations rather than hard gates.

nodes.label: Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby public board APIs
nodes.rationale: Fixed hosts, ten-second timeouts, redirect refusal, JSON responses, and at most 500 jobs bound each refresh.
nodes.norm_label: greenhouse, lever, and ashby public board apis

nodes.label: Reviewed exact-host HTTPS intake
nodes.rationale: Disabled by default; terms-dated allowlist, public DNS validation and connection pinning reject credentials, non-default ports, redirects, private/reserved or mixed DNS answers, non-text content, and oversized responses.

nodes.label: Deep link and local test-outbox providers
nodes.rationale: Deep link prepares mailto without sending; test outbox writes one mode-0600 JSON file after packet, action, and runtime approval, without network access.
nodes.norm_label: deep link and local test-outbox providers

nodes.label: Optional loopback Ollama companion
nodes.rationale: Selected evidence is bounded to 8 KiB per claim and 32 KiB total; draft text stays unverified and copy-only. Exact-tag assurance records the digest and fails closed without cloud fallback.

nodes.label: Job marketplace expansion plan
nodes.rationale: Code-owned foundations and approved ATS execution are implemented; new-source rights, a licensed-feed bake-off, real dataset provenance, and qualified review remain external gates.

nodes.label: Source-specific rights gate
nodes.rationale: Written access, display, caching, retention, canonical-link, deletion, and termination rights precede new source activation; SmartRecruiters execution remains disabled.

nodes.label: Role Availability
nodes.rationale: Publication state and verification health are distinct; two complete misses at least six hours apart may close a role, but partial failures and elapsed verification TTL cannot.

nodes.label: Three-layer H-1B evidence ledger
nodes.rationale: Current role wording, current employer policy, and historical government records stay distinct; historical absence is not negative evidence and cannot increase fit rank.

nodes.label: R1 synthetic stopped-copy recovery drill
nodes.rationale: Implemented pnpm recovery:drill uses disposable data, verifies complete-copy hashes, export parity, six packet artifacts, tenant isolation, lock ownership, approval reset, interrupted-action quarantine, and stored deletion recovery.

nodes.label: R2 external deletion-suppression ledger
nodes.rationale: Not implemented: a backup predating deletion can resurrect erased data. Separate suppression ownership, retention, key lifecycle, replay, and interruption design precede managed restore.

nodes.label: R3 hosted recovery acceptance
nodes.rationale: Deferred deployment-specific encryption, retention, credential recovery, drills, and measured recovery targets are not qualified by the synthetic local drill.

nodes.label: scoring_rules_v1 ordinal match and coverage gates
nodes.rationale: Confirmed evidence determines bands; inferred mappings cannot score, unknowns lower coverage, and blockers stay outside averages to avoid unsupported probability claims.
nodes.norm_label: scoring_rules_v1 ordinal match and coverage gates

nodes.label: Server-trusted government provenance manifest
nodes.rationale: Exact archive, layout, row-set and transformation checksums bind an edition; caller-supplied provenance or drift blocks signal writes.

nodes.label: Qualified government language review
nodes.rationale: A server-trusted review binds the immutable display and limitation contract so historical evidence cannot become an unsupported immigration conclusion.

nodes.label: Source capability and permission contract
nodes.rationale: Technical accessibility is not permission; adapters declare reviewed discovery, linking, assistance or authorized external-action capabilities.

nodes.label: Proposed TypeScript modular monolith
nodes.rationale: Keep business rules, evidence provenance, authorization and approvals framework-independent while bounding API, database, worker and storage infrastructure.

nodes.label: Dependency compatibility, security and license gate
nodes.rationale: Active releases and discovery pins do not prove safety or compatibility; upgrades require advisory, transitive-dependency, install-script, provenance and lockfile review plus inventories and notices.
nodes.norm_label: dependency compatibility, security and license gate

nodes.label: Platform-owned exact-host URL retrieval approval
nodes.rationale: Terms and data rights, applicable robots review, budgets, named approver and kill switch authorize retrieval; tenant policy may only narrow it.

nodes.label: Versioned government and occupational datasets
nodes.rationale: Pinned downloads, periods, layouts and transformations make evidence reproducible; historical records do not establish current sponsorship.

nodes.label: Local-beta substitutions and closed production gates
nodes.rationale: Runnable candidate-side slices do not establish hosted production acceptance; passkeys, hosted isolation and jobs, reviewed corpora, visual gates and external delivery remain separately gated.
nodes.norm_label: local-beta substitutions and closed production gates

nodes.label: evidence_strength_unweighted_v1
nodes.rationale: The implementation exposes supported, source-linked and candidate-attested counts without reconstructing historical values; the contract deviation from weighted requirements remains open.

nodes.label: packet_v2 candidate-selected composition
nodes.rationale: An ordered Evidence selection binds exact Profile Version, current Match Publication and role content hash; frozen inputs reproduce the canonical hash.

nodes.label: Append-only candidate-authored Submission Records
nodes.rationale: Candidates record external submissions after performing them, including exact approved formats or a materials gap; these are not employer delivery receipts.

nodes.label: Inspectable Match Evidence Lens
nodes.rationale: Stored supported, source-linked and candidate-attested counts explain the separate unweighted Evidence Strength ordinal without changing fit bands.

nodes.label: Reviewed URL intake DNS-to-body deadline
nodes.rationale: One ten-second deadline and incomplete-stream rejection preserve bounded intake alongside exact hosts, pinned public DNS and redirect denial.

nodes.label: Synthetic stopped-copy recovery drill
nodes.rationale: The drill checks schema 15, six Packet artifacts, isolation, approval reset, interrupted actions and deletion recovery without touching candidate data; old backups can still resurrect deleted data.

nodes.label: Tenant-scoped transaction currentness
nodes.rationale: Consequential transitions recheck Profile, Match, role, evidence, artifact-manifest and submission identity under tenant-scoped locks to reject stale inputs.

nodes.label: Candidate-approved Discovery Profiles
nodes.rationale: An explicit search contract binds one Evidence Profile; resume evidence does not silently become preferences and missing fields remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Pure Role discovery projection
nodes.rationale: A frozen dashboard snapshot and injected evaluation time centralize joins, replay, filtering, grouping, comparisons and coherent counts while the workbench owns rendering and actions.

nodes.label: Complete-source publication freshness
nodes.rationale: One complete miss means possibly_closed; only a second complete miss at least six hours later can close a Role, while failed or partial runs cannot.

nodes.label: ats_routing_v1 read-only employer routes
nodes.rationale: Approved Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby routes are fixed and tracking-free; candidate rechecks record publication evidence without redirects or application submission.

nodes.label: Server-owned source execution registry
nodes.rationale: Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby are enabled; SmartRecruiters and unapproved sources remain non-executable until source rights are approved.

nodes.label: Bundled static Noto fonts
nodes.rationale: PDFs embed only used glyphs from pinned static Noto Sans, Noto Sans Devanagari and Noto Sans SC assets, avoiding runtime system-font and network dependencies.

nodes.label: Two-byte glyph alignment
nodes.rationale: fontTools 4.63.0 derivation uses glyf padding=2 because fontkit short-offset subsetting can lose visible glyphs while text extraction still passes; tests decode every embedded glyph outline.

nodes.label: PACKET_TEXT_UNSUPPORTED refusal
nodes.rationale: Every grapheme needs full coverage in one bundled font; unsupported glyphs, format controls or non-whitespace controls refuse before artifact writes while saved candidate records remain available.

nodes.label: Bounded ToUnicode and ActualText mapping
nodes.rationale: Grapheme-aware chunks of at most 32 UTF-16 units preserve source wording across shaping and wrapping within extractor limits; combining-mark chunks use empty outlines to retain textual order.

nodes.label: SQLite single-writer lock sidecar
nodes.rationale: The operating system releases the exclusive lock on process exit or crash while .nimanto-lock.sqlite stays in the database directory; it contains no candidate records and must not be deleted while a process runs.

nodes.label: Legacy .nimanto-lock marker
nodes.rationale: Older clients do not serialize stale-marker recovery. A known dead owner can recover, while an empty, malformed, or live marker blocks startup; ordinary DATA_DIRECTORY_IN_USE requires stopping the owner.

nodes.label: Schema version 15 migrations
nodes.rationale: Each migration is recorded after commit so interruption resumes from the last completed step. Newer-schema databases are refused, while idempotent base and tenant-trigger definitions replay at every open.

nodes.label: Manual-role operation ledger
nodes.rationale: Repeated manual creation resolves to the existing Role. Version 15 also flags legacy identity review, records Answer Block topic and prompt provenance, and corrects migration-marker times; internal operation records are excluded from export v10.

nodes.label: Stopped full-directory backup and restore
nodes.rationale: Every process using the data directory must stop. Database, packet artifacts, outbox, launch secret, and lock sidecar stay together; online backups, point-in-time recovery, and schema downgrade support are not claimed.

nodes.label: Older-backup deletion suppression gap
nodes.rationale: Restoring a copy from before tenant deletion can resurrect deleted data because an external deletion-suppression ledger is not implemented.

nodes.label: pnpm recovery:drill
nodes.rationale: A temporary stopped-copy rehearsal checks six artifacts, byte and record parity, database ownership, tenant isolation, runtime reset, interrupted actions, and stored deletion requests. It ignores runtime data directories and never backs up or restores the real workspace.

nodes.label: Private invitations
nodes.rationale: Public signup is disabled. Email-bound single-use invitations expire after 72 hours, create empty isolated workspaces, and remove the token hash and intended email on acceptance. Finished tombstones are retained for at most 30 days.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Production hosted identity gates
nodes.rationale: Passkeys, account recovery, TLS termination, and hosted identity remain deployment gates beyond local invitation tokens and cookie sessions.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Docker self-hosting
nodes.rationale: The digest-pinned container disables public signup and demo login, stores data in a named volume, and remains bound to loopback because internet exposure is not certified.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Owner-only local filesystem modes
nodes.rationale: POSIX directories are tightened to 0700 and content files to 0600. Windows mode bits are not a complete ACL policy, so private-profile placement is required and an ACL installer remains a future delivery gate.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Resumable workspace deletion
nodes.rationale: Deletion fences later tenant writes and captures exact outbox cleanup inventory before removing rows, artifacts, outbox files, and session; incomplete local cleanup is reported separately from complete deletion.

nodes.label: Seven-day deletion status token
nodes.rationale: The sessionless bearer token permits public status and resume after deletion removes the session; it is held only in the receipt page and lost on reload unless copied.

nodes.label: Internal deletion reconciliation
nodes.rationale: API startup and authenticated worker recovery finish incomplete cleanup without a candidate token. Completed tombstones expire after the public token window, but pending work is never age-pruned.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Scheduled public-board refresh
nodes.rationale: A cycle claims at most three schedules and imports at most 500 roles per source, with deduplication and bounded retries. Five consecutive failures produce a dead letter; scheduled work cannot prepare packets or perform external actions.

nodes.label: Application Dossier
nodes.rationale: The read-only case file joins current role and Match, packet and assurance history, candidate ledger, actions, and Submission Records without reconstructing employer history or acknowledgment.

nodes.label: Candidate-authored Submission Records
nodes.rationale: The candidate records actual channel, destination, and time with the exact current approved packet formats used or explicit uncaptured materials. Nimanto neither performs the submission nor calls the record a receipt.

nodes.label: packet_v2 candidate-selected composition
nodes.rationale: One to eight ordered confirmed claims from the exact Profile Version bind the current Match and role; changed frozen inputs fail closed, and identical inputs produce the same canonical packet hash.

nodes.label: document_assurance_v1
nodes.rationale: Structure and configured rules bind exact packet and manifest hashes. A changed hash or superseding assurance blocks approval without claiming truth, writing quality, employer acceptance, or delivery.

nodes.label: Optional local Ollama draft
nodes.rationale: Only candidate-selected confirmed claims go to loopback. The unverified result is copy-only and never becomes Packet content without a separate candidate action.

nodes.label: Use current Profile Version
nodes.rationale: Older Application bindings block packet composition, action creation, and Submission Records. Explicit rebinding resets obsolete export approval to Prepared but preserves externally submitted or withdrawn status.

nodes.label: nimanto-local-beta-v10 inspection export
nodes.rationale: The wrapper contains nimanto_export_v10 records and histories but excludes discarded raw bodies, sessions, invitation secrets, deletion internals, and generated packet files; it is not a restore archive or replay proof.

nodes.label: Playwright WebKit installation
nodes.rationale: pnpm exec playwright install webkit runs before pnpm test:e2e in the documented verification sequence.

nodes.label: Published inventory checksum verification
nodes.rationale: The v0.10.1 SHA-256 manifest checks the CycloneDX and SPDX inventory assets. GitHub separately generates tag source archives, and Nimanto ships no signed installer or desktop binary.

nodes.label: 429 RATE_LIMITED
nodes.rationale: A burst receives wait-and-retry feedback rather than falsely indicating a failed local service.

nodes.label: Ambiguous-action reconciliation
nodes.rationale: A provider effect may already have occurred before local persistence became uncertain, so the record is a do-not-retry audit trail requiring outbox or mail-client inspection.

nodes.label: Stored profile Match and packet history
nodes.rationale: Comparisons disclose exact stored values and mutable fields without claiming causality, lineage, immutable job history, or replay guarantees.

nodes.label: Tamper-evident local activity receipts
nodes.rationale: Dashboard reads verify internal receipt hashes; those unsigned records are not external acknowledgments.

nodes.label: Exact-approved external actions
nodes.rationale: Creation, approval, and execution each recheck the current Packet under the packet-generation lock. A newer Packet makes earlier approval historical.

nodes.label: Runtime execution switch
nodes.rationale: Execution requires the current Packet, separate exact Action approval, and the switch on; every API restart resets the switch off.

nodes.label: Exact-session mutation fencing
nodes.rationale: A replaced or revoked session is rejected before the handler runs, and the old workspace clears before refresh so the rejected write is not assumed committed.

nodes.label: Separate exact-candidate publication, main, and Pages receipts
nodes.rationale: A prepared ledger does not establish release publication, main integration, or Pages deployment; each requires its own exact-candidate receipt, while earlier records retain historical provenance.

nodes.label: External action authorization gates
nodes.rationale: Optional URL intake requires operator-owned exact-host and terms-review configuration. External actions separately require the current Packet, assurance, exact Action approval, and a runtime switch that resets off.

nodes.label: Pre-deletion backup restoration limit
nodes.rationale: Recovery checks use disposable stopped copies. A backup from before deletion can restore deleted data; external suppression remains unimplemented.

nodes.label: WebKit disabled-submit focus regression
nodes.rationale: A disabled submit control can remain active until a deferred blur.

nodes.label: Captured-control focus restoration guard
nodes.rationale: Handle the captured disabled control while respecting focus that has moved elsewhere.

nodes.label: Bounded focus assertion
nodes.rationale: The Career Ledger journey checks Add activity and Save answer using a bounded assertion that verifies restored focus.

nodes.label: Test-only suppressed-restoration probe
nodes.rationale: Suppressing restoration must still fail the bounded focus assertion; the document states a required negative-control behavior, not a receipt proving a pass.

nodes.label: Packet PDF bundled-font embedding
nodes.rationale: Embed bundled fonts for supported Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Devanagari, and CJK glyphs; this is a bounded coverage claim, not universal Unicode support.

nodes.label: Unsupported-glyph, format-control, and non-whitespace-control refusal
nodes.rationale: Refuse generation before artifacts are written when unsupported glyphs, format controls, or non-whitespace control characters occur; saved evidence remains unchanged. The control-character refusal is qualified to non-whitespace controls.

nodes.label: DOCX viewer font dependency
nodes.rationale: DOCX display still depends on fonts installed in the viewer.

nodes.label: Packet Composer keyboard-focus retention
nodes.rationale: Retain keyboard focus through evidence selection, edge reordering, and generation.

nodes.label: Application Dossier Match Publication history pagination
nodes.rationale: Page retained Match Publications across Profiles and role revisions.
nodes.norm_label: application dossier match publication history pagination

nodes.label: Application Dossier late-response isolation
nodes.rationale: Prevent late history responses from another dossier or a replaced session from overwriting the current dossier history.

nodes.label: Unchanged-role recheck observation timestamps
nodes.rationale: Update observation timestamps on unchanged-role rechecks without invalidating the current Match or Packet; preserve existing historical hashes and receipts. A pre-fix role can nevertheless need a fresh Match and Packet once after its first ordinary refresh because the stored historical hash is not rewritten during upgrade.

nodes.label: Substantive-role-change Match and Packet staleness
nodes.rationale: Substantive role changes still make the current Match and Packet stale.

nodes.label: Schema 14 revoked-tenant deletion recovery
nodes.rationale: Avoid rewriting revoked tenants records before pending deletion recovery erases them during upgrades from schema 14. This does not add external backup suppression or make pre-deletion backups safe to restore without review.
